name: 76015 · Arlington, TX
findings: ZIP 76015 (Arlington) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76015 (Arlington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76015 (Arlington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
